testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-save-cart-for-simple-product.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify save cart functionality for simple product

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in, empties the cart, adds a simple product with a checkbox add-on and a second simple product, saves the cart under a new name, moves it back and checks product 1, then adds a third simple product, saves it into the existing saved cart, moves it back and checks product 3. Cleans up the saved cart and cart.
steps: Sign in with the test account; empty the cart; delete leftover saved carts whose name starts with cartNameBase
Add product1 (quantity 1) with its checkbox add-on (addOnCheckboxId) and product2 (quantity 1); cart shows 2 line items
Save the cart as cartNameBase + timestamp; check success message, Saved Cart heading and breadcrumb
Search the saved cart list by name and read its id
Move the saved cart back to the cart (2 line items) and check product1: name, add-on description, SKU, unit price, row total
Add product3 (quantity 1), open the cart (3 line items) and save into the existing saved cart; check success message and heading
Move the saved cart back and check product3: name, SKU, unit price, row total
Delete the created saved cart, empty the cart, log out
stateChanges: Registered user's cart: emptied, products added, emptied at cleanup
Saved cart created by the test (cartNameBase + timestamp), updated with product3, deleted at cleanup; leftover saved carts with the same prefix deleted at start
assertions: Alert contains cartSavedSuccesssMessage after saving a new cart and after saving into the existing cart
Saved Cart heading visible; breadcrumb myAccount_SavedCartBC visible
Saved cart is listed by name (row id truthy)
Product1 line: name, "Checkbox : " + addOnDescription, "SKU: " + sku, unit cost equals price, row total close to price x quantity
Product3 line present by name: name, "SKU: " + sku, unit cost equals price, row total close to price x quantity
evidence: Title: 'verify save cart functionality for simple product'; step labels 1) to 7) match the flow
Spec line 89: addProductWithAddOns(product1.sku, product1.quantity, [addOnCheckboxId]); lines 90 and 122: addProductOfAnyType for product2 and product3
Spec line 56 asserts the add-on as "Checkbox : <description>", so product1 needs a checkbox add-on (addOnDisplayType checkbox)
